data.title: ML Metrics Collection Fix
data.summary: Fixed ML data collection system that was losing 99.6% of training data due to hook configuration issues

sections.Problem:
ML data collection was losing 99.6% of training data:
- Only 19 chats captured vs 5,000 target
- Sessions.jsonl showed no data after Dec 27, 2025
- Hooks configured in project .claude/settings.local.json weren't running
sections.Root Cause:
Two issues found:

1. **Test Isolation Bug**: temp_experiments_dir fixture only patched experiment_module, not metrics_module. Tests were writing to real metrics.jsonl.

2. **Hook Configuration Conflict**: Global ~/.claude/settings.json had a Stop hook that was overriding/conflicting with project-level hooks. Project hooks weren't being executed.
